subject: Exec approval request — Solaris BI hosted API concession
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@solarisbi.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Ari Rosen <ari.rosen@solarisbi.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing request: hosted API volume discount

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the cost controls (particularly the KV caching demo). We're getting close to finalizing our vendor selection for model serving and want to see if Redwood can give us aggressive commercial terms for our first-year on-hosted API usage.

High-level ask: 30% off list Hosted API usage rates for year 1 in exchange for a 12-month committed spend of $250k (payable monthly). Solaris BI will also agree to a 6-month pilot signature by Friday to lock pricing.

Key points:
- Expected token volume month 1: ~200M tokens, ramp to 1.2B tokens by month 6
- Use case: real-time inference for clinical insights (low latency requirement)
- Procurement timeline: PO requested by 12/10/2026

Attached is our master account plan (Solaris_BI_MA_plan_v3.pdf) and an initial SOW.

Can you escalate for exec pricing? We know this is a big concession but Solaris is strategic for our healthcare vertical roadmap.

Best,
Priya Singh
Head of Cloud Engineering
Solaris BI
priya@solarisbi.com

--
Attachment: Solaris_BI_MA_plan_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page stub)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: priya@solarisbi.com, ari.rosen@solarisbi.com
Date: 2026-11-27T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing request: hosted API volume discount — ask: exec approval for >20%

Marcus / Mina,

Forwarding Solaris' ask. External wants 30% off hosted API list for year 1 with a $250k commit. They are promising a fast ramp (200M -> 1.2B tokens). Deal ID DL-2026-0912 in HubSpot.

Why I'm escalating:
- Request exceeds standard deal desk thresholds (>20% requires exec signoff)
- Works across our metrics: high token volume but may pressure per-token margin if we don't use batching/kv caching aggressively

Attached: Redwood_SOW_draft.docx (placeholder) and Solaris_BI_MA_plan_v3.pdf (from Priya). Also adding a quick commercial summary I'll pull together this morning.

Ask: Can we authorize a 25% concession (instead of 30) as a path that protects unit economics, with conditions: 12-month committed spend, monthly invoicing, and an SLA guardrail for latency? If you need different numbers I can propose alternatives.

Karthik
Sr. Dir, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

--
Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, stub)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-27T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing request: hosted API volume discount — ask: exec approval for >20%

Karthik — thanks for the heads up. A few quick questions before I escalate to the exec committee:

1) Incremental unit economics: what's the expected blended gross margin at 25%? Need to know GPU-hours token cost assumptions (are they on g5 or dedicated?).
2) Precedent: any existing account with a similar concession in the last 12 months? (we should avoid resetting price bands)
3) Risk: what's the churn/replacement risk post-year 1 if they only want list pricing after the concession?

If you can summarize in a one-pager I can route to Sarah and finance. Also add the HubSpot deal link (you included DEAL-9123 in Jira).

Marcus Lin
VP, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

--
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-9123

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: priya@solarisbi.com, ari.rosen@solarisbi.com
Date: 2026-11-27T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing request: hosted API volume discount — ask: exec approval for >20%

Folks — quick commercial summary attached (Solaris_commercial_summary.xlsx). Key points below to answer Marcus' items:

- Proposed concession: 25% off list for 12 months (vs Solaris request 30%)
- Committed spend: $250k over 12 months (minimum monthly $20.8k)
- Expected billed token profile: month1 200M / month6 1.2B / avg Q1-Q4 blended 650M/mo (see sheet)
- Estimated Redwood cost: with standard batching and KV cache, marginal token cost ~ $0.000005/token; at blended volumes the concession reduces gross margin from ~62% to ~45% for year 1
- Upside: we position them as a strategic healthcare reference with joint case study and product feedback; pipeline influence: they have a channel partner that could push 3 additional pilots in 2027
- Retention guardrails: discount tied to commitment and a 30-day ramp milestone (if they don't hit month3 ramp, discount is renegotiable)

Attachments: Solaris_commercial_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub).

If you and Mina are comfortable I recommend approving 25% as an exception with the conditions above + Legal to confirm SOW termination language. If approved I'll send the formal commercial addendum and timeline to Solaris procurement.

Karthik
Sr. Dir, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

--
Attachment: Solaris_commercial_summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, stub)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: priya@solarisbi.com
Date: 2026-11-27T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing request: hosted API volume discount — ask: exec approval for >20%

Thanks for the summary and the numbers. I'm approving a one-year, 25% hosted-API usage concession for Solaris BI under the following mandatory conditions:

1) Minimum committed spend of $250,000 over 12 months (monthly invoicing).
2) Discount only applies to Hosted API usage tokens per the SOW (no add-ons unless separately authorized).
3) 30-day ramp milestone: if Solaris fails to reach 60% of projected tokens by month 3, discount will be suspended pending review.
4) Legal must sign the commercial addendum with explicit termination for convenience language and recovery clause for overages/under-commit.
5) Revenue to be routed through Deal ID DL-2026-0912 and tagged in HubSpot; renewal owner must be assigned to Sales Ops for Q4 2027 review.

Please get Legal and Sales Ops looped and produce the addendum. Marcus — please flag any precedent concerns to the exec committee but I don't need to escalate further provided the above controls are in place.

Mina Haddad
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

--
Note: Approval is conditional; we will need signatures on the addendum and SOW before pricing becomes effective.
